summary: The official Thailand site announces Imagine at Lanna Resort from 30 December 2026 to 1 January 2027. This inaugural Thailand edition combines music, visual and performance art, workshops and a New Year lightshow in a wooded setting outside Chiang Mai. Dates and venue are published, but ticket sales and the detailed programme need reconfirmation.
whyGo: Spend New Year in an immersive arts gathering with participatory workshops and music.
Combine a two-night festival with camping rather than commuting into town after each evening.
bestFor: Music and arts enthusiasts comfortable with an inaugural event.
Travellers who can reserve the final two nights of December.
skipIf: You want a quick central-city countdown or a confirmed artist-specific concert.
You require published accessibility arrangements before committing.
duration: Two nights across 30 December–1 January; reserve three calendar days plus travel. Individual admission and performance times are unconfirmed.
cost: Current ticket prices could not be verified. The organiser says camping is included with every ticket; budget separately for equipment, food, transport and any off-site accommodation.
hours: Event dates are confirmed on the organiser website; gate hours and daily schedules are not verified.
bestTime: Arrive during daylight on 30 December as a planning preference, allowing time to settle in before evening activities.
gettingThere: Lanna Resort is in Ban Pong, Hang Dong, near Highway 1269. The organiser estimates 40 minutes from Chiang Mai airport. A shuttle is promised, with De Charme Hotel named as the city pickup point; timetable and fares remain unpublished in the checked guidance.
booking: Use the official Thailand website and recheck its ticket route before paying: the homepage early-bird link returned 404 during research. Verify the full price, admission dates, refund terms and accommodation arrangements first.
accessibility: Step-free routes, accessible toilets, viewing areas and shuttle accessibility are not documented in the checked pages. Ask the organiser about specific needs and ground conditions.
practicalTips: Arrange your return journey before the event; do not rely on finding a late-night car at the venue.
Camping areas are advertised with drinking water, showers and toilets; confirm whether tent hire is available.
Pack a warm layer and comfortable shoes for outdoor evenings.
decemberNotes: This explicitly advertised edition runs 30 December 2026–1 January 2027. It falls at the very end of a December trip and continues into January; keep onward travel flexible until operational details are confirmed.
uncertainties: Ticket price, working purchase route, lineup, gate hours and refund conditions need verification.
Shuttle timetable, fares, camping equipment provision and accessibility arrangements remain unclear.
Gallery imagery predates the inaugural Thailand edition and does not show the future event.
